content:
This week Apple updated its third-party accessory lineup, adding eight new products, including the Aqara Thermostat Hub W200.

Aqara's Thermostat Hub W200 was announced at CES 2026 this January and went on sale in April.

The Aqara Thermostat Hub W200 is priced at $169.95 on the Apple online store—$10 more than Amazon, though it may be more convenient if you have Apple Store credit or are already shopping at Apple.

Apple's decision to bring this product into its online and physical stores reflects considerable endorsement. Notably, the product offers several Apple Home exclusive features, including Apple Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance.

Apple also sells the more expensive ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium, which supports built-in Siri and native HomeKit, rather than connecting to HomeKit via Matter.

However, the Aqara model remains quite attractive, supporting Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance through the Apple Home app.

This week's Apple Store inventory update also added another Aqara smart home product: the Aqara Climate Sensor W100.

In addition to the two Aqara smart home products mentioned above, Apple now also sells the following six accessories:

  • Nimble Powerstack Charger/Battery System
  • Herschel Cloudform 14-inch MacBook Sleeve
  • Herschel Cloudform 16-inch MacBook Sleeve
  • Herschel Cloudform MacBook XL Backpack
  • CalDigit Thunderbolt 5 (USB-C) Pro Cable (2.0m)
  • Logitech Spotlight 2 Presentation Remote

Coming up, everyone is looking forward to the iPhone Duo series at the end of the month, as well as the rumored new "HomePod" with a display, expected to debut in October.
